name: amulet
displayName: Amulet — Pi Agent for VS Code
description: AI coding agent for VS Code, powered by the pi runtime.

amulet.binaryPath.markdownDescription: Command name or absolute path of the external pi-compatible agent executable (for example `pi` or `omp`). Runs in RPC mode. **Changing this restarts the runtime.** Scoped to machine so a workspace's `.vscode/settings.json` cannot override it (security: this value is used to spawn a child process).

amulet.agentDir.markdownDescription: Directory where the pi runtime stores auth, models, and sessions. Defaults to the runtime's own default (`~/.pi/agent`). Passed as `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR`. Scoped to machine so a workspace cannot redirect it.

amulet.defaultModel.markdownDescription: Optional default model pattern passed to the runtime at startup (for example `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5` or `provider/id:thinking`). Leave empty to use the runtime's configured default.

enumDescriptions: Do not send any thinking level - pi, the model config, and the provider defaults decide.
Explicitly disable thinking for every model that supports it.
Extra high reasoning effort (only where the model maps it).
Maximum reasoning effort (only where the model maps it).
amulet.thinkingLevel.markdownDescription: Thinking level the extension applies to the runtime. Leave on `disabled` to send nothing: the level then comes from pi's own settings, the resumed session, and the model default, and you can still pick one per session in the chat box. Any other value is sent as `set_thinking_level` at every runtime start (and live when you change it), overriding those defaults; pi clamps it to what the selected model supports. Switching back to `disabled` takes effect on the next runtime start.

amulet.autoCompact.markdownDescription: Automatically compact context when the conversation grows large.

amulet.autoRetry.markdownDescription: Automatically retry on transient provider errors (rate limits, timeouts).

amulet.expandThinking.markdownDescription: Show reasoning (thinking) blocks expanded instead of collapsed. Toggle this from the chat menu: **Uncollapse thinking**. Individual blocks can always be collapsed or expanded by clicking their header.

amulet.privacyMode.markdownDescription: Censor sensitive text in the chat view: your user name inside paths, plus everything listed in `amulet.privacyRules`. Toggle this from the chat menu: **Privacy mode**. Only what the chat paints is rewritten, so a screenshot, a selection copy and a pasted excerpt all stay clean — while the conversation itself, the session file and every string sent back to pi keep their original text (Branch, Quote and the runtime still see the real paths).

label.description: Optional name, used only to report a rule that could not be applied.

search.description: Literal text to replace. No regular expression, so `$`, `.` and `\` are ordinary characters.

pattern.description: JavaScript regular expression to match instead of a literal `search` (it wins when both are set). Always matched globally.

flags.description: Flags for `pattern`, for example `i`. `g` is always on and `y` is ignored.

replace.description: Replacement text. `$1`-style group references work with `pattern` and are literal with `search`.

amulet.privacyRules.markdownDescription:
Search/replace pairs **Privacy mode** applies to the chat text, in order, after its built-in rule (a user name used as a path segment becomes `username`). Each entry needs `replace` plus either `search` or `pattern`:

```jsonc
[
  { "search": "/media/jang/home/PortableApp", "replace": "/media/user/home/PortableApp" },
  { "label": "api keys", "pattern": "sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}", "replace": "sk-REDACTED" }
]
```

A rule that cannot be compiled is skipped and reported in the Amulet output channel; the other rules still apply.

amulet.notifyOnTurnDone.markdownDescription: Notify me when a run finishes writing its final report, so the chat can be in the background while the agent works.

amulet.notifyOnApproval.markdownDescription: Notify me when a pi extension is parked waiting for an answer — a tool-approval prompt (for example `pi-gate`), a subagent asking for more turn/time budget, or any other dialog that blocks the run. While one is unanswered, a status-bar entry keeps counting them; the notification itself disappears, the question does not.

amulet.notifySystem.markdownDescription: Also deliver notifications to the operating system's notification centre while this VS Code window is not focused (`notify-send` on Linux, `display notification` on macOS, a balloon tip on Windows). Nothing is ever run through a shell: the notifier is spawned with an argument array, and a missing one falls back to VS Code's own notification.

amulet.extraArgs.markdownDescription: Additional command-line arguments passed to the pi runtime at startup. Scoped to machine so a workspace cannot inject args.

amulet.contextEditing.markdownDescription: Let Amulet manage what the model can re-read: **Omit from context**, **Edit context content** and **Revert to this message** on a tool result or a reply. Implemented by loading a small pi extension that Amulet ships (`pi -e`), so **changing this restarts the runtime**. Needs pi 1.4 or newer; older runtimes simply show none of these actions. Scoped to machine because it changes the arguments the child process is spawned with.
